# GDAM Godot fixture

Empty Godot consumer fixture for addon tooling. It has no game scene or export preset.

Install the [Komizo release](https://github.com/nicodes/komizo#install) matching `komizo.lock`, then run `komizo check`. The gate validates the project and imports a disposable copy with the verified engine, leaving authored resources unchanged. Export templates are unnecessary for this fixture.
